notes.title: Multiplayer Lobby Update
notes.content:
We've made some updates to the multiplayer lobby browser.  

- All multiplayer games in all regions will now be displayed in the lobby browser.  

- In progress games and full games will be displayed at the bottom of the list with their buttons redded out. 
 
-Private games are not shown in the lobby browser.  

- Games are sorted based on distance from the region you first connect to, so games in regions closer to your "home region" will be listed first.  

Hopefully this will streamline joining multiplayer games and show players that they are not alone in the Prodiverse.

notes.title: Campaign Updated!
notes.content:
The time is finally here for you to check out our new campaign update. We've been working hard on it for months and the time has arrived! The update should be live on Steam / GoG / Gamepass Pc. 

There are a few [b]New Maps[/b] and most importantly [b]NEW MUSIC[/b]! Andrew Hulshult came back to work on some bonus material for the game, and let me tell you... it's [url=https://twitter.com/AndrewHulshult/status/1430401102776832000?s=20]HAWT[/url]. 

[h2]Corruption[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c9a18a20d20f9bdcb631b282d336d5bb3f79a4f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Atonement[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/0899553fdfa1737672f21237bf754bf2c73bcdbe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Progenitor[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/a4a6eaec34844264b21c415bef1e233e5e91ddbf.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hexarchy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/012c4a7d80143975caddba909e2c091152f14fcc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trials: Grenade[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/ea4ad43196e18c2d964fb7cf26e0021387f1a999.jpg[/img]

[h1]More News[/h1]


Welcome [url=https://twitter.com/MoistEyeball]Iori_Dyson[/url] to the team. Dyson joined after getting [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yJBF2PjFi8]3rd place[/url] in our first Mapcore level design competition. Since then, he's gone on to art Corruption, Grenade Trial, and build the map Atonement. 

Special thanks goes to SpookyBerry for building Hexarchy and helping test the latest set of maps!

Co-op testing has been coming along nicely and we are pretty close to a stable build for public testing. 

We've already starting working on the next set of levels to go into the campaign and wanted to thank those who have been testing with us. You guys are helping make the maps better!

[h2]Coming in the future![/h2]

[h3]Fuel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/6b04dc4bcb0480b4bbd90fc35d78fe1f5b91405d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/7ae27e81c0c238c5da5901082f8517007d0b078e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Work in progress: [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/edce545e28cfe02fdc4ab7ed946149698e837024.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/d0a3589bfdc36fa928a4b84d3b1732e7ffc4e953.jpg[/img]

We've been posting micro updates on the steam forums every other week, which should help keep you informed about what we are working on. 

Ok, back to it! Enjoy the update, and let us know what you think! 

- Prodeus Team

notes.title: Workshop / Music / Weapons / News!
notes.content:
[h1]Workshop Profiles[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/964800/view/5820315468884390149]Patch Notes[/url]

You can now Follow / See who's Following, making it easier to keep up to date with your favorite mappers and their levels or Structures

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/fcffdacf61406f811522bfea5c79c1e74bea0f37.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/30d4e7b93cc014c4fc526c169fab444814beaa98.jpg[/img]

Just finish playing a really cool level? Wanna see if that mapper made anything else? Now it's super easy, just clicking on the search button near their name will take you directly to their other creations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/6f985e3552469e9dd78b8526790783a1bd8e222d.jpg[/img]

Really like someone's work? Just hit that follow button on the brand new Profiles page :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/222883e2c36b0d72601a350dca2af98bbebe4b45.jpg[/img]


[h1]Level Editor: Prefabs Workshop[/h1]

There are a lot of new changes to the Level Editor, but the big one we'll talk about today is the User Prefab / Structure Workshop that's now directly built into the level editor. 

Ever need a new door? Just open open up the Structure Workshop and search for Door, then when you find something you like, drag and drop it directly into your level! It's super fast, and if you want to modify the Structure afterwards, you can merge it into your level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/6bb7005957fc1327cef376b18eb0d09ee3207e5c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/098137e24f5175502dd367bd1d9a62468b224846.jpg[/img]


[h1]Mapcore X Prodeus mapping contest[/h1]

Check out the amazing work the community has been up to. Some really jaw dropping moments and set pieces! If you fancy a play, head on over to the workshop now! Don't forget to Follow those mappers you love. 

[previewyoutube=cDxeqhz4Y_k;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]New Midi Music - In game now![/h1]

We've been working with the very talented [url=https://twitter.com/JamesPaddock]James Paddock [/url] on getting a full Midi album in-game for Prodeus! The time has finally come! You can now enable the Midi tracks to play through the campaign. Take a listen to a sample track below and consider supporting Jimmy by [url=https://jamespaddock.bandcamp.com/album/prodeus-the-midi-soundtrack]checking out the whole album on his Bandcamp[/url]. 

[h3]To enable Jimmy's Midi music, Go to: Options / Audio / Midi [ON][/h3]

[previewyoutube=zFk8PBUV3YU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Weapons (NOT IN-GAME)[/h1]

Although these weapons are not ready to be used in-game, we wanted to showcase off some of the cool new guns that are shaping up quite nicely! Let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/a4c35c9f499caec90448bc05bfe2a50417e096bf.jpg[/img]
More Screenshots:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/ec9bf97b1db4608146d17ba0071af2883866278e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/13aa36c743d899751ebfd81492c33e170487b9dd.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/284cf9a4fc3ced88919bf5d22f7515509d6e1b3e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/633a14a9e6a2b373638c7caf7800829fd863618e.jpg[/img][/url]

More Screenshots:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c2f489d92fedc1ec77604acc0b62a8643828477f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/8f5e7cf6884fed4e144dc5542ca96b4773ac4949.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/cc684799f09142ab08f40f45f13d414b081abc12.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c7f9a08b62b8980bb252649424909d2540783635.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/b437d5760c769202006b54f5b55bb64356b47652.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/328476e2c468b192d14a9118bad08a4d4858a7ad.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/108906b7c56b922291ceeb5d2fe2272c13dc17d3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/529bb39a4e2cd083a039ab8f7cbc0aaf570254f3.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/a5b6dbe26885f32673f4ceb74a0102adeff287de.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/3986701de9694b62521a0ae3b109305b5ab65216.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Sneak Peak[/h1]

A behind the scenes look at some new campaign levels we're working on. Hope you enjoy ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/f1c94b0cab8d6a8d9d8a9f62ad4a5288e99e90e8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/168b727762a166a6607218b840506307d820a5ce.jpg[/img]


[h1]T-Shirts are finally here[/h1]

A lot of you have been asking us for T-shirts, so we got some made! If you like that sort of thing, check um out below! There is a Hardcore Metal album style shirt, and a fun chibi style shirt featuring some of our main characters having a water balloon fight :)

Shout out's to [url=https://twitter.com/theyetee]Yetee[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/PlayHumbleGames]Humble[/url] for making it happen :)

Store: https://theyetee.com/collections/prodeus

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/f3c975d20d907c00a2a6054650fb5265b2d95b23.jpg[/img]
close ups!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/1e9d192af1bbf5ab355725c02e8be1cfd1ffffe4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/0c17d06289994787ab0b67a744a73139d6379414.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/bd81dce6ce804ce91449230e5904069efb72a4f2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/160f583234216ac692e48f7b89d7e1663ee81a4d.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Thanks again for the support![/h1]

We'd like to thank everyone for their continued support and all the kick ass mappers out there making levels on the workshop. So many awesome things going on right now, the future is bright! We can't wait to update the campaign in the future with more official levels. 

In the meantime, keep spreading that zombie jelly all over the walls! 

- Prodeus Team

notes.title: April 2021 - "0.1.0 to 0.1.9" Patch notes

[b]New build in testing 0.1.1[/b]
added: Online prefab (structure) browser in editor.
added: your previous ratings for maps / Prefabs are highlighted.
fixed: all the campaign images had a bunch of metadata bloat, re-saved them and re-saved all campaign images on server (1/20th previous size) campaign data downloads much faster now.
fixed: leaderboard not loading correct map in level end scene.


[b]New build in testing 0.1.2[/b]

added: Look buttons added to PC input list as suggested by Garrett(Monolyth-42) on discord, defaults to arrow keys

[b]New build in testing 0.1.4[/b]
added: first pass loading screens for startup and loading maps
fixed: follower list displays followers correctly 


[b]New build in testing 0.1.5[/b]
added: progress bar for downloading maps and campaigns

added: Insta-Gib to damage volumes

updated: color palette color picker
added: OBJ export
updated: Undo *should* now work with all inspect-able fields
updated: loading screen changes

fixed: toggle node no longer toggles nodes connected to its relay output.
update: changed "Ref Map" to "Structure"
update: moved tool bar menu items around and added some icons
fixed: updating a color will update everything using that color
update: added latest obj export stuff
various ui tweaks and bug fixes


[b]New build in beta 0.1.8b[/b]
fixes to all bugs reported by the Discord community


[b]New build in beta 0.1.9[/b]
added: "Ease In" and "Ease Out" to movers
fixes to all bugs reported by the Discord community

notes.title: Big Update: 1/15/2021
notes.content:
[h1]Company News[/h1]

Wow, the game came out into early access and was extremely well received! This has been such a wild ride for us on the team and we are excited to continue working towards 1.0 release. Throughout the rest of the year, we will be putting out new content updates and holding more mapping contests! The community has grown so much and we're just trying to keep up. The feedback and support has been amazing, thank you so much :)

[h1]Mapcore Level Design Contest![/h1]

The Mapcore contest is still running to the end of February. So be sure to join our discord and get to mapping! Lots of cool prizes, including $1,500 to first place! Check out more info here!

[previewyoutube=dHhOdMhnNa8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Kickstarter Backer news![/h1]

Excalibur Shotgun Skin is now ready for Kickstarter Backers who purchased this tier! To access, go to the "Unlockables" tab in your options menu and select "ON". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/6b0b4ae2f485cc22d5ebdfc24848e5397a9aa0c1.jpg[/img]

Gold plated with a sleek bone design, also heats up when shot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/f0d42c63c46076c0136d20ee3f3317371472bdb7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Feature Updates:[/h1]

New Plasma Rifle homing beacon line. Now you can visualize where the bullets are heading, even behind cover! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/9ce3343a389394b5ee3a6c30870c7882ac554516.jpg[/img]

Mike created a new crosshair for each of the weapons. Now you can see more important information directly on the crosshair! Things like charge, and ammo count can now be seen when firing or using the alternate fire mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/a7ca285c63f7401062f8f1f7cb24503025df2335.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/e45972947501bf28b81e352ed7ab0d9310c49cbb.gif[/img]

Dynamic crosshair not your thing? Don't worry, we have some options to disable this content and swap out for a more static version, that can be also scaled up or down in size. The new static options are DOT, CROSS, and CIRCLE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/a00090c21ce563b9d75b3038855b1e9447dd06ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c96d9269842fb53ebc92e5768f64e29a41e30a53.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/23625e497fd96e4283d5cab08eeda221095dbde8.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Auto-Shotgun Work-in-Progress![/h1]

We're happy to be showing off some more progress on our new Auto-Shotgun model. Here below is a highpoly untextured model. Hope you like it! 

EDIT: It's currently not in-game or available to use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/900880a2f4475776af78f857eeba8b2f6b8f0fd6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/51ed535a14aeda1bf61c1bd97a37338f35d64282.jpg[/img]

[h1]Workshop Updates: [/h1]

New filters allow users to find [b]Staff Picks[/b] and [b]Contest Winners[/b]. Staff picks are hand picked levels that reach a high quality bar. Excellence in gameplay and visuals is a factor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/f24f8e214910c3a2f9a1044976236413e8c4fb9f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/5ce70ca44a949cd102fa44f8f17e4c6763225efc.jpg[/img]

To find staff picks in your browser, simply look in the bottom right corner of any thumbnail for a glowing medal. This indicates that our team has vetted the level and consider it of good quality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/08624eadf5b349767ff8ebb6e25e0a1efc970639.jpg[/img]

You can now easily find any Contest Winner with our brand new filter. Speaking of which, be sure to check out the top 3 winners from our previous challenge. The True Addiction, Thermal, and Transit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/26053d53b002cc65a1b25154a13b1b13ecd11c54.jpg[/img]

[h1]Graphic Options[/h1]

Some new graphics settings should help players with lower end PC's to boost their frame rate. Check them out in the Graphics tab towards the bottom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/0a47af5a3782d3d048937f229a8c459faa8858a9.jpg[/img]

[h1]In Closing[/h1]

We wanted to thank the Steam community for hanging in there and helping us by providing feedback. 

Here's hoping 2021 is the best year for Prodeus yet!

- Prodeus Team

notes.title: Feature Update: 12/6/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Feature Updates: [/h1]

- Added Multi-Bind to allow multiple inputs per weapon select, will go to the next highest weapon you have or loop around

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/1209874b1a0978297af95a7b5f64d973d5fd8c61.jpg[/img]

- You can now use the mouse wheel to scroll through menus and community maps

- Added Automap legend

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/0b23ce9d9207417e30ffd66ea2cc6fe927432759.png[/img]

- Added mappable input for Automap drag

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/40f619a7236b14c5d841861c85a36bee75a62fea.jpg[/img]

- Added mouse cursor to weapon select.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/8f70221abc7958c4826cd6ed65eb366e6f4f6d68.gif[/img]

- Overhauled gore splat effects for better performance.

- New Advanced section, for those who get stutter issues. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c6b7e86fe3fe0ac6c18a0c1d037485fdb09f4d35.jpg[/img]

The physics options are specifically to fix the weird rubber banding issues.  Usually physics runs at 50hz independent of the frame rate.  On low end machines this can cause a cascade of physics updates on a single frame that can bring down the frame rate even more.  And when the physics and framerate are not locked movement may be a little jerky.  So we set it to run once a frame so movement would be smooth and low end machines wouldn't suffer too much.  But it seems to have some weird effects on some machines. So now there's an option, but changing it will really only help if there's a problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33970004/c0622fcd0cd5ade79392ea9ccf5107f6eecf59da.jpg[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter Alpha Demo![/h1]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/prodeus/prodeus/posts/2847927]Kickstarter Main Update Link[/url]

That's right! We said we weren't going to, but we couldn’t wait any longer! This is our way of saying [b]thanks for all your wonderful support[/b]. Who better to give an exclusive look at our Alpha Build than our backers!

Before we make our next balance pass, we’d love to hear what you like, don’t like, and where we can improve the game.

[b]BONUS:[/b] We’re also including the [url=https://twitter.com/ProdeusGame/status/1232412002347339776?s=20]Pro-Engine Level Editor[/url] that we used to create the game. We want [b]you[/b] to test the tools and make some fun maps, be the first on our Workshop!

notes.title: Dev Update: Automap Item has been added! Never get lost again!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4iv_BOaqzic

Something that every old school fps needs is an automap.  As environment art has become more and more complex, the idea of the automap has become less feasible.  With Prodeus, we're bringing it back.

The automap records everything you see, the environment, the items, the enemies and lets you explore the world from a different vantage point.

Low on health?  See if there's a pickup you've left behind.  Got turned around in a level? Pop open the automap and see if there's something you missed.  It might even help reveal a secret or two.

Finding a GPS tracker will reveal the parts of the level you haven't seen yet with a less opaque style so you can still tell where you've been.

The best part is, the automap works with every level right out of the box, even custom community made levels, no extra steps required.

Check out our kickstarter and stay tuned for more dev updates!

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/prodeus/prodeus

Thanks!

- Prodeus Team
